Name: Community Bundle Item Tooltip
Author: musbah
Description:
This mod just adds an item tooltip if the item is in the community bundle, note that if an item has already been placed in a bundle this specific bundle won't show up in the tooltip.

Compatible with: CJB Show Item Sell Price mod (tooltips will not overlap and both will show).

Note: The game has a bug that lets you put some non object items in a bundle (so the wrong item), I fixed my mod so that these items
don't show a tooltip as of version 1.0.6 .

To install this mod:
[list=1]
[*][url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Install SMAPI if you don't already have it.[/url]
[*]Unzip the folder in stardew valley's mods folder.
[/list]
Source Code: [url=https://github.com/musbah/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/musbah/StardewValleyMods[/url]
